arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/flake8/processor.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('flake8.processor')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from argparse import Namespace
from flake8.processor import FileProcessor
options=Namespace(hang_closing=False,indent_size=4,max_line_length=79,max_doc_length=None,verbose=0)
processor=FileProcessor('example.py',options,lines=['one\n','two\n','three\n'])
result=processor._noqa_line_range(1,2)
print('noqa_range',result)
assert result=={1:'one\ntwo\n',2:'one\ntwo\n'}

PYREPLAY
